title: SomaliMusicCorpus master dataset record (v1)
description: One track of the SomaliMusicCorpus-HAR-v1 dataset (Harvard AWM Spec Coll 103, Maryan 'Aryette' Omar Ali Collection, 1955-1991). Fields marked nullable are populated progressively as pipeline stages complete; a record is valid at every stage of enrichment. Produced by apps/ai-service/scripts/process_harvard.py stage `assemble`.

track_id.description: Canonical corpus id. `track_NNNN` indexes the Harvard HOLLIS catalog export row; `AWM-HAR-NNNN` is the publication alias.

source.description: Provenance statement, e.g. 'Harvard AWM Spec Coll 103'.

license.description: License statement covering catalog metadata vs audio use.

artists.description: Performer names, Somali orthography first, romanization in parentheses where the catalog provides it.

cassette.description: Synthetic cassette grouping (cassette_NNN) derived from catalog row structure; physical call numbers are not in the export CSV.

recorded_date.description: Recording date recovered from the catalog title, when present.

era.description: Stylistic period: early nationalist (voice+oud), golden age, late period (Western instrumentation).

genre_labeled.description: Expert-assigned genre (human label; the training target).

singing_ratio.description: Duration-weighted share of Whisper segments flagged as sung. Transcripts over sung material are stored but treated as unreliable lyrics.

dominant_notes.description: Top scale degrees by voiced duration (Phase D4).

modal_center.description: Duration-weighted dominant degree — a computational proxy for the tonal 'home', not an expert judgment.

avg_cents_deviation.description: Mean signed deviation from the Somali scale reference per degree, in cents — the corpus-level distribution of these values is the paper's central empirical result.

ornament_types.description: Counts of classified note events (Phase D3 heuristics).

instruments_detected.description: e.g. voice, oud, organ, guitar, violin, clarinet, saxophone, frame_drum.

embedding_id.description: pgvector row UUID for the 768-d MERT embedding.

quality.description: Phase B1 audit metrics (SNR estimate, clipping, silence).

files.description: Relative or absolute paths of every artifact derived from this track. Only `original` is guaranteed; the rest appear as stages complete. Excluded from the `_lite` export.
